newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU makes no progress on budget pact - diplomat.
newsitem.headline: EU makes no progress on budget pact - diplomat.

text.p: European Union finance ministers have made no significant progress on defining exceptional economic circumstances under an EMU budget stability pact, an EU diplomat said on Monday.
"There has been no significant progress," the diplomat said, adding that the ministers had moved on to considering the size of fines for running an excessive deficit under the budget pact.
It was unclear whether the ministers would return to the subject of exceptional circumstances, the diplomat added.
The diplomat said the negotiations on exceptional circumstances were split between Germany and the Netherlands on one side and the EU's other 13 members.
"Everybody has been expressing the same positions as before. The Germans and Dutch were at one end, everybody else at the other," the diploamt said.

Germany has wanted a definition to include a decline in GDP of 2.0 percent over four consecutive quarters. Other nations have argued that such a condition was too restrictive and would ignore the different economic conditions within the EU.
